rules.execution: Prior completed close generates signal; next open eligible only within +/-1 prior ATR of signal close. Rank candidates by prior 20-session average turnover, ties symbol. Initial 2 prior ATR stop; indicator reversal exits next open; otherwise stop first and holding cap close. No profit target. Existing positions cannot release same-day closing proceeds for new entries; at most 5 positions and 2 per current industry. Flat restart per evaluation window; force liquidation at last close with costs.
rules.liquidity: Prior close >= Rs50; prior 20-session average turnover >= Rs10cr; ATR/price 0.5%-6%. Current constituents, not historical membership.

costs.note: Scenario costs; not actual broker tariffs or personal income tax.

rules.pre_recent_selection: Choose recent candidate using earlier and middle base returns only, require both positive and >=30 closed middle trades. Rank minimum annualized return/max(drawdown,5) across those two periods; ties configuration id. Freeze before computing recent results. Choose middle candidate using earlier only, positive and >=30 trades. If no candidate qualifies stay cash. No pristine holdout: these market periods were inspected in earlier research.
rules.exploratory_gate: Each base window positive, recent and middle doubled-cost positive, >=30 closed recent trades, no held-bar gaps. This is a screen, not statistical validation. All 144 comparisons disclosed; multiple-testing and survivorship bias remain.
